root: ^I'm glad you made it in your first time out there.
^Those monsters are the "Skinwalkers" that i told you.
^They are mindless killers that only seek to fullfil their mother's wishes, she's know as "Matriarch".
^Their original form is a blob of slime, but they can transform into animals and even humans.
^Be careful, the more you upset the Matriarch, the stronger the minions she will send after you.
^Oh! And for now try to follow the lights in the florest...
^I don't know why... But something about those lights is connected to the "Matriarch".
^Have you already taken your upgrade tho?
